purpose: Teach: モト/ごとき/にたいして/ウォーク/驚愕/ダース/貴女/だけれども

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんのモト同僚と再会された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father and one of his old colleagues ran into each other again.
lines.style: Soft, remembering gaze fixed on a point in the distance. Voice thin with years and affection. Each phrase given its own breath. Pausing between thoughts like pages turning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、私ごときで申し訳ないって謙遜されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he was so humble about it all, wasn't he, dear? So like him.
lines.style: Gentle correcting warmth. Knowing smile in the voice. Not disagreeing, but adding what she remembers. Warm tick upward on the final question, drawing him in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはご近所にたいして親切だった
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father was always kind to the people around us.
lines.style: Patient certainty. Not asking her to confirm but building the picture together. Slow, deliberate. The voice of someone who has thought about this many times.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、夕方のウォークを欠かさなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and he never missed his evening walks, did he? Not once, dear.
lines.style: Brightening slightly with the memory. A small laugh hidden in the words. Affirming and adding detail only she would know. Playful, not correcting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが終戦に驚愕された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was deeply shaken by the end of the war.
lines.style: Voice drops lower, becomes more careful. Acknowledging something serious beneath the surface. Slower pace. Not looking away but holding steady.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、缶詰をダース単位で備蓄されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he stockpiled cans by the dozen afterwards, didn't he? We had so many.
lines.style: Understanding without judgment. Matter-of-fact tone that holds compassion. Practical memory delivered gently. No bitterness, only clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「貴女が私の宝」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father once told me, "You are my treasure."
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the words—not breaking, but tender. Each word given weight like a gift being placed carefully. Quiet wonder that he said it at all. A pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、寡黙だけれども深い愛情をお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was quiet, wasn't he? But oh, the love he carried—so deep, so steady.
lines.style: Soft affirmation with undercurrent of emotion. Voice steady but warmed through. Almost a whisper, intimate. Not a question but a shared truth, drawn close between them.
